description: Soft or rigid crown sitting on a continuous brim. One recipe; variants differ only in parameters.

parameter_doc.brim_root_y: frame row where the brim starts (seating anchor; vanilla Bucket Hat = 10, Fishing/Straw = 9)
parameter_doc.crown_h: crown rows above the brim root
parameter_doc.crown_top_hw / crown_base_hw: crown half-width (incl. outline) at top / at base
parameter_doc.top_round: pixels removed per side on the top crown row
parameter_doc.band_h: rows of band just above the brim root (0 = none)
parameter_doc.brim_hw: front-view brim half-width (frame is 20 wide, so 10 = full width)
parameter_doc.brim_droop / droop_power: how far the lobes hang below the lip, and how that drop is spread across the lobe
parameter_doc.brim_tilt: rows of brim top surface seen above the root at the flanks (wide brims seen from above)
parameter_doc.tip_round: 1 = trim the top corner of each brim tip
parameter_doc.side_*: right-view asymmetry: crown shift toward the back, brim reach and droop front/back
parameter_doc.brim_top_follow: 0 = brim top stays level and only the underside drops (vanilla bowl brim); 1 = whole brim bends down (skirt)
parameter_doc.lip_hw: half-width of the front lip (the brim part in front of the face); the rest of the brim is lobes

identity: tall straight-sided crown with flat top
short brim angled down all round
lower crown with a cord band
longer brim that droops at the sides
small round dome crown with a ribbon
full-width thin brim, flat near the crown, floppy at the tips
